# Version 3.116.0
> **Stable v3 platform refresh** · Released December 2, 2024 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.116.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.116.0)

> **Supersedes [3.0.0](3.0.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.116.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.116.0 stabilizes the v3 line with WebAssembly improvements, updated platform support, and the modernized API surface. It rolls up the v3 previews, including newer Skia and native dependencies, expanded view controls, and compatibility work for current .NET workloads.

## Breaking Changes

- **Legacy APIs and platform integrations changed in v3** — This stable release includes the v3 API cleanup and platform package updates from the preview line. Replace obsolete APIs and verify package references and target frameworks before upgrading. ([#2539](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2539), [#2789](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2789), [#2989](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2989))

## Engine

- **Skia and native dependencies refreshed** — The stable v3 line includes the Skia m116 update and refreshed bundled graphics and text dependencies. — ❤️ [@Redth](https://github.com/Redth) ([#2622](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2622), [#2624](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2624), [#2829](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2829), [#3026](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3026))

## API Surface

- **Expanded managed graphics APIs** — Adds span-based point operations, SKBlender, animation support, and additional picture and shader APIs. — ❤️ [@Youssef1313](https://github.com/Youssef1313), [@alexandrvslv](https://github.com/alexandrvslv) ([#2630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2630), [#2748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2748), [#2830](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2830), [#2883](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2883), [#2949](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2949), [#3030](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3030))

## Platform

- **WebAssembly and desktop integrations improved** — Adds multithreaded and SIMD WebAssembly support and resolves Blazor base-path and .NET 9 runtime issues. ([#2620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2620), [#3081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3081), [#3087](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3087), [#3089](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3089), [#3093](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3093))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.0

Bundles the refreshed HarfBuzz version introduced during the v3 preview line.
